entities.name: RibBA (B2RIG7)
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed Porphyromonas gingivalis RibBA; 405 aa, 100% identity and coverage.
Bifunctional riboflavin-biosynthesis enzyme with EC 3.5.4.25 and EC 4.1.99.12 annotations.
Curated annotations report Mg2+ or Mn2+ and Zn2+ binding.

entities.name: GTP pyrimidine formation
observations: RHEA:23704: GTP + 4 H2O → 2,5-diamino-6-hydroxy-4-(5-phosphoribosylamino)-pyrimidine + formate + 2 phosphate + 3 H+; UniProt function text describes DARP formation with formate and pyrophosphate.
